objective: Bake Rush core rules: bake, sell and upgrade as pure, server-authoritative functions, with unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: Bake rejects taps faster than the tier's bake time (GDD D)
Sell totals are correct for every tier and capped at maxCoins (GDD D)
Upgrade is rejected when coins are short or the tier is not the next one (GDD D)
verification: Lune unit tests in CI; QA thread reviews the PR
evidence: Local run 2026-10-24: 22/22 Lune tests pass (12 reward + 10 bake).
notes: Server service, client UI and DataStore persistence are separate tasks (PILOT-003, PILOT-004).
